purpose: Real-data kernel-to-differential-equation-to-analytic-function experiment on a simplified magnetic profile.
observable: Euclidean norm of three real magnetometer channels, in frozen reference instrument units.

protocol.scalar_coordinate: s=x in published metres; y varies within the narrow band.
protocol.geometry_selection: Training positions only, no field values.
protocol.original_spatial_hole: Not used in this separately defined 1D experiment. Whole acquisition trials remain held out.
protocol.candidate_families: All seven supports in z'=c0+c1*z+c2*z^2, plus coordinate polynomials of derivative degree 0..3.
protocol.selection: Smallest derivative support plus one kernel reference, meeting all validation tolerances. Otherwise label failure and show best-value fallback.
protocol.test_reuse: Exploratory reuse of acquisitions already scored previously; not a fresh confirmatory experiment.

units: reference Invensense numerical recording units; not independently calibrated SI

data_provenance.citation: Solin, Kok, Wahlstrom, Schon, and Sarkka (2018), Modeling and interpolation of the ambient magnetic field by Gaussian processes.
data_provenance.licence_note: No explicit licence file was present in the pinned upstream tree. Upstream requests attribution; do not infer additional redistribution permissions.

derivative_scope: Kernel derivatives are model outputs. No independent measured current, gradient, or normal derivative is supplied.
